biography.value: Straw, flies and the warm smell of horse. Beasts sold, hired and boarded, with tack to match and feed by the day.

description.value: A two-wheeled cart drawn by a single beast.

Feed for one animal for a day.
Stabling and grooming for one mount, per day.
